Title: Tanay's Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anjali - 38 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Rajesh - 36 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Tanay scratches his head.]

Anjali: "What happened?"

[Tanay whispers something to Mother.]

Tanay: "One more time!"

[Tanay takes the bag from Mother.]

Anjali: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Anjali and Rajesh stand near him.]

Tanay: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay eats his breakfast at the table.]

Tanay (happily): "How beautiful!"

[Tanay takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Anjali (laughing): "Rajesh, listen!"

[Tanay munches on an apple.]

Anjali: "Hmm, I see."

[Tanay sips hot tea from a cup.]

Tanay: "That's great!"

[Tanay serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Tanay: "I knew it!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Night

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Let's begin."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Anjali: "Oh wow!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Tanay: "What a day to remember!"
